title: cristobalia hispida
intro: Cristobalia hispida, commonly known as  Chrysolaena hispida or Chrysolaena floribunda, is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health due to its antimicrobial and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cristobalia hispida may include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant effects, which can help alleviate symptoms associated with respiratory conditions. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
